Movway

A TMDB-powered movie, TV, and anime streaming experience with discovery, search, continue-watching, subtitles, and multiple playback providers.

Visit live project ↗View source on GitHub ↗
ReactTypeScriptTMDBStreaming
RoleProduct design and frontend development
CategoryStreaming
Project01 / 03
Overview

Building a focused product around a real workflow.

Movway brings discovery and playback into one focused entertainment interface. It helps viewers move from browsing to watching quickly while preserving useful state such as continue-watching progress.

Key capabilities
01

TMDB-powered discovery for movies, television and anime

02

Search and browsing across multiple entertainment categories

03

Continue-watching state that makes returning effortless

04

Subtitle support with multiple playback provider options
